name: HyperX Cloud III Wired Gaming Headset 53mm Angled Drivers Black Red
shortDescription: HyperX Cloud III Wired Gaming Headset Black/Red (Custom-Tuned 53mm Angled Drivers / DTS Headphone:X Spatial Audio / Detachable Noise-Cancelling Mic with LED Mute / Signature Memory Foam & Leatherette / Aluminum Frame
descriptionHtml:
HyperX Cloud III Wired Gaming Headset Black/Red (Custom-Tuned 53mm Angled Drivers / DTS Headphone:X Spatial Audio / Detachable Noise-Cancelling Mic with LED Mute / Signature Memory Foam & Leatherette / Aluminum Frame / USB-C, USB-A & 3.5mm Multi-Platform Compatibility / Official 1-Year Local Warranty)

Experience legendary comfort and ultra-clear audio precision with the HyperX Cloud III Wired Gaming Headset, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by an official 1-Year agent warranty. Built on the iconic Cloud heritage, the Cloud III features re-engineered 53mm angled dynamic drivers for immersive game audio, dynamic memory foam ear cushions wrapped in premium leatherette, and a durable aluminum frame built for long sessions. Upgraded with an ultra-clear 10mm noise-cancelling detachable microphone with an LED mute indicator, versatile USB-C, USB-A, and 3.5mm connectivity, and lifetime DTS Headphone:X Spatial Audio activation via PC software.
